battery_criteria_a.name: wave_speed
battery_criteria_a.threshold: backward wave speed in [14, 22] km/h (emergent, unseeded)
battery_criteria_a.detail: detector: stack: slant-stack peak of the two-way demeaned field on 15 s x 75 m bins over front speeds [-40, -2] km/h in 0.25 km/h steps, peak/median contrast >= 3, edge peaks rejected

battery_criteria_a.name: sensitivity_grid
battery_criteria_a.threshold: penetration {1%, 2%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%} x compliance {25%, 50%, 80%, 100%} grid published with CIs

battery_criteria_a.name: no_collisions
battery_criteria_a.threshold: zero SUMO collisions in every run, each run recording the counter
battery_criteria_a.detail: 1 collision(s) in 1 of 20 run(s) that record the counter; FlowState internal standard (CLAUDE.md §3.3; owner decision 2026-10-04), not an FHWA or DOT criterion

battery_criteria_a.name: no_locks
battery_criteria_a.threshold: no run locked (no queue standing without discharge for 10 min or more), every run recorded
battery_criteria_a.detail: no lock in 20 run(s); FlowState internal standard (CLAUDE.md §0.1; docs/I94_COLLAPSE_DIAGNOSIS.md §7, 2026-10-07), not an FHWA or DOT criterion
